method: Transcribed from actual native AX results returned by Simulator after built-in Run pack self-test, in this chat; not generated from Jest

checks.name: file system: replace, list, size, chunked read, rename onto an existing directory is refused
replacing a file interrupted before the new text is moved in: the previous complete text comes back
install, update, confirm and roll back across restarts
a resource changed on disk: caught at the next start, the previous pack serves
a resource deleted from disk: caught at the next start, the previous pack serves
an update with a missing file is refused, its staging is removed, and the active pack is untouched
an update interrupted before it is installed leaves staging that startup sweeps away
a pinned journey keeps its pack files through an update; releasing lets them go
storage pressure: an update that does not fit is refused before staging, the real free space admits one that does
two venues stay separate: each resolves its own pack, and updating one leaves the other alone
